# glinet_mesh (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet mesh base settings. Joining an agent to the mesh still requires the stock pairing flow.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable mesh networking.
- `log_level` (String) Mesh log level.
- `log_path` (String) Mesh log path.
- `mode` (String) Mesh role: `controller` or `agent`.
- `new_join_confirmed` (Boolean) Whether a new join was confirmed.
- `onboard` (Boolean) Onboarding state reported by the firmware.
- `ts_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the mesh guest/IoT VLAN split.
- `ts_guest_vid` (Number) Mesh guest VLAN ID.
- `ts_iot_vid` (Number) Mesh IoT VLAN ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
